prompt: What does a double arrow sign mean?
bankAnswer: Traffic may pass on either side of obstruction

decisions.prompt: What does a double arrow sign mean?
decisions.signAlt: A yellow diamond sign with two black arrows pointing down and apart

options.text: Traffic must merge to one side of the road
options.consequence: You thought traffic had to merge to one side and moved right, into the car beside you. It had to brake and swerve to miss you.

options.text: Traffic may enter from either direction ahead
options.consequence: You expected traffic to enter from both sides and stopped to look, in a moving lane. The driver behind had to brake hard and swerve around you.

options.text: Traffic may pass on either side of obstruction
Traffic must stop before proceeding forward
options.consequence: You thought you had to stop before the island and stopped in a moving lane. The driver behind had to brake hard and swerve around you.

successText: You held your lane and passed on the left while the car beside you passed on the right. Both sides were open, which is all the sign says.
ruleText: A double arrow sign means traffic may pass on either side of the island or obstruction, so stay in your lane and keep moving.

citation.source: FHWA Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices, 11th Edition

verified: Read in the FHWA PDF, Nov 2026: the sign advises "that traffic is permitted to pass on either side of an island, obstruction, or gore in the roadway".
